newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grain prices hit as sterling firms - May 13.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grain prices hit as sterling firms - May 13.

text.p: A firmer sterling against the mark pushed UK cash grain prices lower Tuesday.
Delivered prices fell by 0.50 to 2.50 stg a tonne while fob coaster values were 0.50 to 1.50 stg lower.
However, brokers reported only light trading as buyers sat back and waited for further falls.
"Why buy when the market looks as if it is going to go even lower," said one.
Feed wheat ex-east coast ports traded at 92.50 stg for May and 93.50 stg a tonne fob for Jun.
There were also unconfirmed reports that 98.50 stg had been paid for Nov.
Delivered market brokers reported patchy trading with Milling wheat in the London area fetching 113 stg for Jun.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 94.50 and 93.50 stg for June while 93.50 stg was paid for harvest material.
In the Avon range 94 and 93.50 stg was paid for Jun and 96 stg for Jul.
On south Humberside May feed barley traded at 94 stg while in the Avon four range Jun traded at 94 stg a tonne.
